overall.verdict: A genuinely novel, trust-forward wallet whose absolute-scale bars, signed-frame receipts and 'Enforceable right now' framing beat most self-custody products on safety legibility for power users. It is held back from shipping-grade by heavy jargon, recurring terminology/state inconsistencies (Secured vs Collateral, mismatched signer/entity/frame ids across the set) and several mobile layout defects (clipped chips, colliding CTAs, a mislabelled Assets screenshot).
priority_fixes: Add a plain-language layer (glosses/tooltips) for hub, promised, lane, bilateral, entity id, basis points — unblocks Maya, Fatima, Dmitri
Standardise terminology and re-capture the set from one session so 'Secured/Collateral', signer/entity/runtime ids and frame numbers are consistent — unblocks Tomasz, Kenji, Marcus
Give the order book a comparable depth visual and add a cross-network route+fee view — unblocks Anya, Fatima
Ship the missing dispute/challenge-window flow and an on-chain proof-verify action on receipts — unblocks Kenji, Ravi

Fix mobile layout bugs: clip-proof activity chips, stop collateral buttons overlapping the Swap CTA, hide desktop-only layout control, and correct the mislabelled 12-assets-bottom screenshot — unblocks Lena, Marcus
